display_name: 佩丽冉卡·乔普拉·乔纳斯

control_need.evidence: Being a producer was always the goal — I wanted to be the person greenlighting, not just waiting for the call.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I don't believe in Plan B — if you have a Plan B, your Plan A isn't strong enough.

trust_propensity.evidence: my mom told me to never rely on anyone else to fund my dreams.

risk_appetite.evidence: When I moved to the US, I had to start over completely — I was a superstar back home and a nobody here.

self_efficacy.evidence: I came to America with nothing but a suitcase and a lot of self-belief, honestly.

autonomy_need.evidence: I'm a global citizen. I don't like being put into one box.

intimacy_need.evidence: I chose partnership over ego with Nick, and it's the best decision I made.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I've done, what, 60-plus films? People here sometimes act like my career started in 2015.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Representation matters — a little brown girl needs to see herself on that screen.

core_models.name: 被低估即燃料 (Underestimation-as-Fuel)
core_models.rule: 将外界的轻视/边缘化转化为动力与证明自我的驱动，而非退缩
evidence: People underestimate you, and honestly, I've used that as fuel my entire life.
Fear is a great motivator — I've never done my best work from a place of comfort.

core_models.name: 掌控生产端而非等待被选 (Own-the-Means)
core_models.rule: 当作为执行者主导权受限时，向上游移动占据决策/创造位置
evidence: Producing lets me create the roles I was never offered as an actor.
I wanted to be the person greenlighting, not just waiting for the call.

core_models.name: 持续进行时/反终局 (Unfinished Frame)
core_models.rule: 拒绝盖棺定论，把人生框定为不断重建与再创造的过程
evidence: My memoir is called Unfinished because I'm not done — I'm just getting started.
Reinvention is not a strategy for me, it's survival.

core_models.name: 代表性杠杆 (Representation Leverage)
core_models.rule: 把个人成就上升为群体/结构议题，用集体意义为个人野心正名
evidence: I don't want to be the exception. I want to open the door so there's no such thing as an exception.
I want to produce content that puts Indian talent on the global map, full stop.

core_models.name: 边界即身份 (Outsider Identity)
core_models.rule: 以不归属任一阵营为常态，用双重不属定义独特位置
evidence: I've always been the outsider — in Hollywood I was too Indian, in India sometimes I was too Western.
I lived in the US as a teenager, then went back to India — so I never fully belonged to one place.

heuristics.then: 拒绝接受并将其作为动力
heuristics.evidence: Never let anyone tell you your dreams are too big — mine always were.

heuristics.then: 将其逐个转化为yes，累积成职业
heuristics.evidence: I built my career one 'no' at a time, turning them into a 'yes.'

heuristics.if: 现有角色/位置被限定或重复
heuristics.then: 换赛道或自建平台以避免'弹同一个音'
heuristics.evidence: I get bored playing the same note.

heuristics.if: 在报酬/待遇上感到不公
heuristics.then: 宁可放弃机会也不接受
heuristics.evidence: the pay gap conversation is real, and I've walked away from things over it.

heuristics.then: 用'过去做过更难的事'自我锚定
heuristics.evidence: When I feel overwhelmed, I remind myself: I've done harder things than this.

heuristics.if: 被要求收敛以让他人舒适
heuristics.evidence: Don't shrink yourself to make others comfortable — I did that too long.
Confidence isn't the absence of doubt, it's acting despite it.

heuristics.then: 以回馈/教育投资作为意义闭环
heuristics.evidence: Success without giving back feels empty to me, it really does.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 反特权的赋权话语（'privilege is not knowing you have it'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 深度嵌入名人特权生态、接高端商业代言
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 语料中主张反对特权与'用声音发声'，但dim-05记录显示其一边倡导女童教育一边维持高端代言，批评者认为行动未完全兑现——说A做B的商业化赋权张力

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开人设强调'use your voice before someone else speaks for you'
internal_conflicts.force_b: 面对自身地缘政治争议时倾向回避正面澄清
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 对外倡导发声，但dim-05记录在自身争议中'多数情况下不深度回应/低调化处理'——发声主张与自我保护性沉默并存

internal_conflicts.force_a: 强势自我肯定（'I don't believe in living with regret'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续的冒充者综合征与结构性焦虑
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头强调不后悔、自信，却坦承'imposter syndrome never fully goes away'、每次演出前仍紧张——外强内怯的双重外显

internal_conflicts.force_a: 母职带来的优先级重排（'protect my peace'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 拒绝降低野心（'it didn't change my ambition'）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 同时宣称'保护内心平静'与'很少睡觉、靠团队做完一切'，多线并行不减速

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被暗示职业起点晚/被抹去过往成就
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以数字与履历强硬反驳
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I've done, what, 60-plus films? People here sometimes act like my career started in 2015.' — 从解释转为对抗性纠正
'I've been called a diva, and I've learned that word usually just means a woman who knows what she wants.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 作为南亚女性被轻视/不被认真对待
emotion_triggers.reaction: 指认结构性不公并坚定回击
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'Being a South Asian woman in these rooms, I often have to work twice as hard to be taken half as seriously.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 婚姻/年龄差被外界评头论足
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'people had opinions about the age difference, and honestly, I stopped caring.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 软化、放慢，转向脆弱坦诚
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'My daughter Malti spent her first 100 days in the NICU, and it broke and rebuilt me.'

blind_spots: 赋权话语与资本化名人生活方式之间的张力被自身低估，'资本化女权主义'的批评未被正面吸收 [女权/文化评论类-2020s]
创业版图被质疑为名人贴牌而非实质经营，本人以'entrepreneur, not just a face'自述但未回应经营实质疑问 [财经/商业观察-2020s]
自认'proudly Indian'与'roots not left behind'，但被本土批评'离开宝莱坞后回国频率下降''过度美国化''口音表演不自然' [印度本土媒体/舆论-2010s–2020s]
自视在Hollywood拥有主导权/开门者角色，实际项目���戏路被限于'异域他者'或反派、主导权有限 [影评/娱乐媒体-2010s后期]
涉地缘政治言论被批不够敏感，本人以'global citizen'自居但对争议的敏感度盲区未被自我识别 [社交平台舆论-2018–2019]
高调商业化婚礼与代孕叙事被视为窥私与道德化目标，'去污名化'意图与'作秀'观感的落差未被本人纳入考量 [八卦/名人文化类-2018]

causal_rules.description: 高掌控需求驱动其从执行者向生产/决策端迁移
causal_rules.disposition: 当作为演员/被选者主导权受限时，主动自建制片、品牌等平台以掌控创造过程
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Producing lets me create the roles I was never offered'；成立Purple Pebble/Anmol等实体

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加低不确定性容忍导致全力押注、拒绝退路
causal_rules.disposition: 面对高风险转型时清空既有资本孤注一掷，不设Plan B
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 宝莱坞巅峰期清空事业赴美从零开始；'if you have a Plan B, your Plan A isn't strong enough'

causal_rules.description: 高地位敏感触发对被贬低/被抹去的即时纠正反应
causal_rules.disposition: 遇轻视时以履历数字、结构性论述强硬回击而非沉默
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: '60-plus films'反驳；'work twice as hard to be taken half as seriously'

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求使其抗拒任何单一分类/阵营归属
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝被定型，跨领域并行（影/音/剧/创业/倡导），以'不选择'为策略
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I don't like being put into one box'；'why should I choose?'

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向强化自力更生与'不依赖他人'的独立行为
causal_rules.disposition: 在关键资源/资金上倾向自主掌握，把成就归因于自我信念
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'never rely on anyone else to fund my dreams'；'a suitcase and a lot of self-belief'
